WITH WITHDRAW UNDERNEATH (withdraw-01 promoted 10-06 14:39Z): the plan's allowance is bankable.mjs depositPlan, so withdraw's usable-tool rule (min(n-1, usable-1)) and its 10-min anti-redeposit hold both apply; the WITHDRAW HOLD composition test, skipped on 1918bb5, RUNS and passes here. Fixed: every town_deposit click is now withdraw's (craftsync lockstep, tracked, refused when the window changed; the window owned from open to close; withdraw's server-confirmed settleCursor; an unresolved cursor is HELD via holdUnsettled -> transfer_unsettled, never a loaded close; a server-closed window is not closed again); a tool name under withdraw's hold moves NO copy (Codex's 130/40 + withdrawn 120 counterexample); a verified intake records `took` in the town memory (clears withdraw's misses there; the bank's reopen signal); containers the town knows are full/unavailable/unusable/backoff are skipped; a closed bank gets no order. Suite 234/234; anchored mutants 31 of 32 killed -- the survivor bypasses WITHDRAW's own spent-tool rule, which towndeposit's slot rule already enforces (equivalent for this plan). PAPER on the c902d6f variant (56aa04a, sandbox, server read-back, after the reboot the world re-verified peaceful): full bag -> banked exactly the 60-use pickaxe, cobblestone 20, oak_log 10, raw_copper 7, kept the spent and best pickaxes, nothing on the ground; WITHDRAWN: the model's `withdraw stone_pickaxe` took the chest's 60-use copy (hold), the town deposit then banked cobblestone 20, oak_log 10, raw_copper 7 and KEPT the just-withdrawn pickaxe; control: withdrew, no deposit. -- NOT launched.] OWNER 10-05 ~18:30Z: 'yes add automatic town deposit'. MEASURED (bag-creep report 10-05, 24 h, 80 bots): 829 town stays began at >= 34 slots (77 bots, median 9 min; town = 16 h / 12 v of home); 715 carried bankable surplus (median 4 freeable slots); only 231 tried any deposit, 130 succeeded; the median bag left town as full as it arrived. THE CHANGE (bots/src/towndeposit.mjs + skills.mjs town_deposit, chatOnly housekeeping): a bot within 16 h / 12 v of home, bag >= 34 of 36 (its own items().length), a town container within 16, and a plan that empties >= 1 slot -> one deterministic order, evaluated BEFORE the milestone order (a craft-ready rung re-issues its craft every decision; craftroom refuses it at 36/36). One order per town stay (re-armed by 60 s outside town or 15 min), 5 min cooldown, 15 min backoff after a failure. PLAN: the fleet's own depositPlan allowance (standing targets, always-banked ores, spare tools; never ballast, food, stations, chests, dirt, sand), creditCap 64 per VISIT, minus KEEPS as totals: wood units and the COBBLE family to min(held, 64), dirt 16, sand 8, 4 planks (the ladder's means), the iron ladder (raw_iron, iron_ingot, coal...) never, the active rung's wants to a stack, the scaffold reserve; tools by SLOT: spent (<= 10 uses) never, the best usable copy kept. WHOLE stacks only, smallest first. A property test runs every gatherer + SUSTAINING rung's real done() over 400 random full bags at laps 0..540: no rung changes state. EXECUTION: <= 2 town containers (no lids, double-chest halves by block state, never a mine chest), 45 s, a no-dig/no-tower/no-scaffold walk (index.mjs withTownDepositWalk), never walks home, digs, crafts or places; each stack = two left clicks into an EMPTY container slot (destination re-read after the pickup); a failed put-down puts the cursor back; the container is OPENED AGAIN and only stacks the server shows there are credited (bagdelta from the server's bag); an unconfirmable run is failed, never success; a timed-out open is drained before the run returns. Codex: design in parallel (agreed: separate skill, before the milestone order, whole stacks, slot-precise tools, capped by the container), implementation review CHANGE x3 -> APPROVE at 1cb6913 (round 4). PAPER (sandbox, server read-back, sandbox/craft/towndeposit-ab.cjs; 9 candidate trials, 3 control): full bag 3/3 -> banked exactly the 60-use stone_pickaxe, cobblestone 20, oak_log 10, raw_copper 7, kept the spent and best pickaxes, 128 cobblestone, 128 logs, iron, food, dirt; nothing on the ground; one order in 0.6 s. Kept-only bag 3/3 and a 33-slot bag 2/2: no order. Full chest 1/1: one failed run, no click, nothing moved. Two chests 1/1: the first took 2 stacks, the second the rest, logs capped at 10 for the visit, the 120-use pickaxe kept and the 81-use one banked. Nothing on the ground in any trial. CONTRAST, the model's deposit verb on the control with the same bag: banked 151 items incl. the SPENT pickaxe and the BEST one (kept the 60-use copy), raw_iron and coal. EXPECTED: ~2-4 slots per full town stay (report); creditCap 64 and the stockpile keep hold the low end. NOT IN THIS VARIABLE (listed): the model's deposit verb and craftroom's depositTarget still use the base rules (they can bank below the stockpile and bank spent tools by type); apples/food and bone meal still have no exit; duplicate pickaxe crafts unbuilt.

own_lines.note: G1: a banked tool copy at <= 10 uses (the row's tools name@uses), or a banked tool name with no usable copy left in the END snapshot.
G2: banked logs/planks with wood units after < 64; banked planks with planks after < 4; banked cobblestone/cobbled_deepslate/stone with the stone family after < 64 (END snapshot).
G3: a banked name outside standing targets / always-banked ores / tools, or inside the never set (iron ladder, dirt, sand, food, ballast, stations, chests).
G4: cursor_unsettled > 0, or the server bag's loss (bagdelta) > the stacks the server showed in the chest (items left the bag and are not in the chest).
